title.quote: Action-based Representation Learning for Autonomous Driving

analysis.description: This paper explores the use of action-based methods for representation learning in autonomous driving tasks. It experiments with different action-based pre-training strategies to improve the interpretability and performance of autonomous driving models. The study demonstrates that affordance-based driving models pre-trained using action-based methods can outperform traditional end-to-end models while requiring less annotated data.

type.justification: The paper describes the practical application and testing of various action-based pre-training strategies using empirical data collected from autonomous vehicle simulations.
type.quote: In this paper, we show that action-based methods, that focus on predicting the control actions, such as end-to-end driving trained with BC, can be an effective pre-training strategy for learning a direct perception model (Fig. 1).
